note: Public protocol specifications a device can name in its own USB strings. acquire_selfdescription reports a key in named_protocols when one of its `match` substrings occurs (case-sensitive) in any string descriptor; acquire_protocol_spec fetches that key's commit-pinned `sources`, refuses any whose sha256 differs, and splits a source with a `split` marker into sections. Toolchain-side only: never copied into an interpreter workspace.
